This page lists each input of the Speccy GitHub Action, `alternayte/speccy`. [Keep the verdict in CI](/how-to/keep-the-verdict-in-ci/) shows a whole workflow, and [Reply commands](/reference/reply-commands/) lists the replies that record a decision.

| Input | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `config` | `.speccy.yaml` | The path of .speccy.yaml. Speccy reviews the bundles of the folder it is in. |
| `enforcement` | empty | advisory: a verdict never fails the job. blocking: Not Build Ready fails it. Empty: enforcement in .speccy.yaml, else advisory. |
| `models` | empty | The model of each review role, one per line: role=backend:model. "all" sets every role. Backends: anthropic, openai, openrouter, deepseek. Empty: lint checks only. Example: all=anthropic:&lt;model&gt; |
| `anthropic-api-key` | empty | The Anthropic API key, when models uses anthropic. |
| `openai-api-key` | empty | The OpenAI API key, when models uses openai. |
| `openrouter-api-key` | empty | The OpenRouter API key, when models uses openrouter. |
| `deepseek-api-key` | empty | The DeepSeek API key, when models uses deepseek. |
| `server` | empty | Connected mode: the Speccy server that reviews the files with its models. Empty: mode and server in .speccy.yaml, else standalone. |
| `token` | empty | Connected mode: a personal API token for the server. |
| `version` | `latest` | The Speccy release to run, such as v0.1.0. |
| `github-token` | `${{ github.token }}` | The token that posts comments and checks. It needs pull-requests and checks write permissions. |
